messages:
Alex (docs): Quick update: We're formalizing a "deprecation policy" for SDK surface area. First target: Redwood Ruby SDK's legacy sync client APIs (v0.x) will be deprecated in 90 days. Draft policy: https://redwood.example.com/internal/policies/sdk-deprecation

Renee (product): Was there a specific incident that triggered this?

Alex (docs): Not a single incident — we've seen maintenance burden + customer confusion across languages. The policy standardizes timelines, compatibility shims, comms cadence, and upgrade tooling.

Tom (eng): For Ruby specifically: timeline proposal: announce now, compatibility shim in next patch (v1.0.1) for 90 days, server accepts both shapes for 45 days, remove shim in v1.1.0. Also add Codemod to simplify migration.

Vera (security): Any security implications for leaving shims in place? We need to ensure the shim doesn't bypass validation or logging. Recommend a short audit on the shim code before release.

Alex (docs): Good call. Add audit to the checklist. Also: communications plan — Console banner, targeted email to tenants using Ruby SDK (threshold >100k tokens/mo), and a small migration FAQ.

QA-bot: CI alert: examples/ruby-quickstart tests failing on nightly due to old sync client usage.

Tom (eng): I'll prioritize a runtime patch to accept legacy calls for 45 days and push a PR with tests. QA: can you prioritize updating examples in a follow-up PR?

QA-bot: Opening PRs now for examples and adding e2e to validate both legacy and new clients.

Renee (product): We should prepare an internal playbook for customer-facing support: rollback steps, link to codemod, contact list for escalations. I'll draft and share by EOD.

Alex (docs): I'll publish the policy doc and the Ruby migration guide this afternoon. Short migration snippet will be added to the Quickstart and a one-line codemod link.

Tom (eng): Timeline recap in thread: announce now, publish shim in v1.0.1 (today), server legacy-accept for 45 days, deprecation enforcement starts after 45 days, shim removal in v1.1.0. Notify @Tom (eng) and @Renee (product) if customers report breakage.

Vera (security): I'll review the shim PR and sign off on the audit before release.

Alex (docs): docs-bot: created changelog entry -> https://redwood.example.com/changelog/sdk-deprecation-policy (updated by Alex (docs)).

Renee (product): Thanks all. Small ask: include a sample customer email subject and body in the playbook so support can quickly send.
